analysis.reasonEn: RSI cooled from 65.7 to 55.2, easing overbought pressure. A Higher Low pattern formed with the 5-day low at $325.81 exceeding the 20-day low of $309.90. Volume is subdued, lacking conviction for trend acceleration, but technical indicators provide sufficient grounds for entry.
